answer: Because the timing is published against the opal challenge, the gale audit can replay the vine history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 238 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2774 identities would post 1967 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
